name: Nakane Miho
source:
She is the heroine of this story and finds herself caught up in numerous conspiracies.

She is a beautiful, quintessentially Japanese girl with medium-length black hair. She prefers chatting with a small group of like-minded friends or spending time alone reading or listening to music rather than hanging out in large, rowdy crowds.

Perhaps because of this, she isn’t very good at socializing, and she longs for a mature man who understands her; she dreams of one day meeting someone like that.

Her hobby is collecting bags.
